headline: Saturday at the lake: mild fall day with highs in the mid-70s
lede: Saturday, October 3 offers pleasant early-fall Branson weather — highs near 76°F, mostly sunny skies, and very low chance of rain. Perfect conditions for a full day on Table Rock Lake, catching a show, or exploring the Strip and Landing.

featured.title: Table Rock Lake Cruise or Park Day
featured.why: Stable lake levels, mild temperatures, and light winds create ideal conditions for boating, swimming, or hiking with first-time visitors. Pair with a matinee show.
